sloka: इति उक्तः तु तया राम वसिष्ठः सुमहायशाः ।सृजस्व इति तदा उवाच बलम् पर बल अर्दनम् ॥१-५४-१७॥
transliteration: iti uktaḥ tu tayā rāma vasiṣṭhaḥ sumahāyaśāḥ ।sṛjasva iti tadā uvāca balam para bala ardanam ॥1-54-17॥

translations.english: Hearing his words Kamadhenu created an army. O Rama her lowing brought into being Paplavas in hundreds who destroyed the entire army of Viswamitra, while he looked on helplessly.
